name: Customer.io
description_en:
Customer.io turns customer data into lifecycle messages. Its automation builder combines triggers, message and data actions, waits, goals and early exits. Objects add context such as an account or course shared by several people, so a team can model a relationship rather than copy every fact onto every recipient.

The main evaluation question is whether the team can maintain that data model. A useful onboarding design must distinguish a signup event, current account status, message eligibility and the point at which onboarding should stop. Treating all four as a mailing-list membership makes it difficult to explain an unexpected journey. The assessment below is documentation based; no account, API integration or delivery test was run.
description_zh:
Customer.io 将客户数据转为生命周期消息。自动化构建器组合触发器、消息与数据动作、等待、目标及提前退出条件。对象可承载由多人共享的账户或课程信息，团队因而能够建模关系，而不必把所有信息复制到每个收件人身上。

评估重点是团队能否持续维护这套数据模型。合理的新用户引导设计需要区分注册事件、账户当前状态、消息接收资格，以及引导应该终止的时点。若把四者都等同于加入邮件名单，就难以解释异常旅程。以下判断来自文档，未操作账户、接入 API 或测试投递。

core_features.explanation_en: Represent an account or course separately and relate its people to it.
core_features.explanation_zh: 单独表示账户或课程，再将相关人员与其关联。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine custom exit conditions using OR logic.
core_features.explanation_zh: 自定义退出条件按 OR 逻辑组合。

core_features.explanation_en: Render recipient-specific drafts before enabling automatic sends.
core_features.explanation_zh: 启用自动发送前，先生成针对具体收件人的草稿。

core_features.explanation_en: Inspect the reason behind Attempted or Undeliverable before retrying.
core_features.explanation_zh: 重试前检查 Attempted 或 Undeliverable 状态背后的具体原因。

en: Editorial fit: a product team that can define signup, activation and paid-state data for lifecycle onboarding.
Editorial fit: an account-based service needing notices based on relationships between people and shared objects.
zh: 编辑判断的适用场景：能够定义注册、激活及付费状态数据的产品团队，用于生命周期引导。
编辑判断的适用场景：依据人员与共享对象之间的关系发送通知的账户型服务。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Write a small account/person/object schema and an expected recipient table.
steps.zh: 先写出小规模账户／人员／对象结构及预期收件人表。

steps.en: Build an evaluation workflow with explicit goal and subscription requirements.
steps.zh: 创建评估流程，明确目标与订阅要求。

steps.en: Inspect drafts for several synthetic profiles, including one that becomes paid during a wait.
steps.zh: 为多个合成档案检查草稿，包括等待期间变为付费的一例。

steps.en: Document stop, restart and retry decisions before enabling real delivery.
steps.zh: 启用真实投递前，写清停止、重启及重试决策。

items.en: Reliable behavior depends on incoming event and relationship data; no integration accuracy was tested.
items.zh: 可靠行为依赖输入的事件及关系数据；本次未测试集成准确性。

items.en: Draft mode is not a frozen or globally side-effect-free workflow.
items.zh: 草稿模式不等于冻结流程，也不等于整个流程没有副作用。

items.en: Older and current trigger documentation differ; this profile uses current redirected pages.
items.zh: 旧触发器与当前触发器文档存在差异；本稿采用当前跳转后的原页。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Observed public cards: Essentials from $100/month billed monthly, 5,000 people-and-object profiles and 1 million monthly emails; Premium from $1,000/month billed annually; Enterprise by quote. Essentials lists two object types and two workspaces, with $0.009 per additional profile and $0.12 per 1,000 additional emails. SMS volume is custom. The conditional 12-month Startup Program is not a permanent public free tier. No normalized quote is assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 实读公开套餐卡：Essentials 每月 100 美元起、按月付费，包含人员与对象合计 5,000 个档案及每月 100 万封邮件；Premium 每月 1,000 美元起、按年付费；Enterprise 询价。Essentials 列出两种对象类型、两个工作区，额外档案每个 0.009 美元，额外邮件每千封 0.12 美元。短信量需另议。附条件的 12 个月 Startup Program 不等于永久公开免费套餐。不生成标准化报价。

sources.title: Pricing + Plans | Customer.io
sources.research_notes_en: Read current plan cards and comparison. People plus objects are profiles; channel availability does not mean SMS delivery is free. Startup program is conditional.

sources.title: Automation triggers, filters, and frequencies - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read current trigger migration and frequency sections, not cached legacy search text. New attribute/segment triggers remove automatic matchtime behavior; repeat matching requires a fresh match after exit and cooldown.

sources.title: Automation exit conditions - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read September 2026 exit criteria: custom conditions are OR; removing all conditions permits completing the entire journey.

sources.title: Why aren't people entering my automation? - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read entrance troubleshooting, live-event timing, filter evaluation window, subscription distinction and form-update race warning.

sources.title: Create an automation - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read actual automation creation, goal, subscription, limit and block configuration procedures.

sources.title: Sending behavior options - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read per-message sending modes, existing drafts after mode change, journey progression and draft re-rendering. Queue Draft is not a global workflow side-effect sandbox.

sources.title: Review & retry messages blocked by a message limit - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read message-limit troubleshooting: statuses have multiple causes; Undeliverable is not automatically retried, Attempted is; manual retry requires reason inspection.

sources.title: Change the state of an automation - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read stopping with finish versus forced exit, provider recall boundary, restart audience and archive deleting unsent drafts.

sources.title: How we bill - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read profile counting including objects and deleted/recreated profiles, ESP-accepted email counting and overages. Contract details take precedence over public starting prices.

sources.title: Objects - Customer.io Documentation
sources.research_notes_en: Read object type versus individual object and people relationships. Accounts, courses or flights can supply personalization and group context; not proof of a specific integration.

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.en: An account upgrade can concern several administrators, while a course completion concerns one learner. Objects provide shared context; people remain the audience. As an editorial design exercise, write down which system owns each identifier, relationship and status before building a workflow. A segment name alone is insufficient to document who should receive an account-level notice.
sections.zh: 账户升级可能涉及多位管理员，课程完成则可能只涉及一位学员。对象提供共享背景，人员才是受众。作为编辑提出的设计练习，可在建流程前写清每个标识、关系与状态由哪个系统维护。仅有一个分群名称，不足以说明谁应接收账户层面的通知。

sections.title_en: Migration and re-entry need separate decisions
sections.title_zh: 迁移与重入需要分别设计
sections.en: Current attribute/segment triggers no longer infer timing from the old matchtime rules. Backfilled records can qualify immediately unless time conditions exclude them. Every re-match requires a fresh mismatch and match after the previous journey has ended and its minimum wait has elapsed. Fixed intervals also cannot start a second active journey for the same person. A migration checklist should therefore identify both record age and repeat-entry behavior.
sections.zh: 当前属性／分群触发器不再按旧 matchtime 规则推断时间。若没有时间条件排除，补录的历史记录也可能立即满足入场条件。Every re-match 要求前次旅程结束、最短等待期过去后，再次发生从不匹配到匹配的变化。固定间隔也不会为同一人员启动第二条同时运行的旅程。因此迁移清单应同时说明记录年龄与重复入场规则。

sections.title_en: An onboarding workflow with an explainable finish
sections.title_zh: 终点明确的新用户引导示例
sections.en: Consider a hypothetical trial onboarding sequence: qualify the signup, inspect current account state, wait, then offer help only while the person remains eligible. Set conversion or paid-state exit criteria explicitly; current custom exits use OR, so any matching exit is sufficient. Remove all exit conditions only when everyone should complete the sequence. This is an evaluation design, not an observed customer recipe or a claim that every trial integration supplies the needed data.
sections.zh: 可假设一条试用引导流程：确认注册资格、检查账户当前状态、等待，再仅向仍符合条件的人员提供帮助。需要明确设置转化或已付费状态的退出条件；当前自定义退出条件采用 OR，任一满足即可退出。只有所有人员都应走完整条流程时，才移除全部退出条件。这是评估设计，不是观察到的客户案例，也不代表每种试用系统集成都能提供所需数据。

sections.title_en: Draft messages do not freeze a journey
sections.title_zh: 消息草稿不会冻结旅程
sections.en: Queue Draft is the default message mode and is configured per message. People keep progressing through the workflow. Switching to Send Automatically affects future messages; existing drafts still need a decision. Drafts re-render when their message is edited, and changing entrance criteria does not re-evaluate already queued drafts. Review recipient, freshness and content before any manual send. Do not treat this mode as proof that other workflow actions have no effects.
sections.zh: Queue Draft 是默认消息模式，需要逐条配置。人员仍会继续推进旅程。改为 Send Automatically 仅影响后续消息，已有草稿仍需另行处理。编辑消息会重新渲染已有草稿，而修改入场条件不会重新评估已排队的草稿。手动发送前应检查收件人、时效与内容。不能据此认为流程中的其他动作也不会产生影响。

sections.en: An unsubscribed person can enter an automation without receiving its messages. For event-triggered entry, verify that the event was processed after activation and that required filters matched within the documented 30-minute window. A form can also race with attributes changed by that same submission. For message-limit failures, inspect the reason: Undeliverable is not automatically retried, while Attempted is. These statuses cover other causes too.
sections.zh: 已退订人员可能进入自动化，但不会收到其中的消息。排查事件触发入场时，要确认事件在激活后才被处理，且所需筛选条件在文档说明的 30 分钟窗口内匹配。同一次表单提交引起的属性更新也可能产生竞态。排查消息上限导致的失败时，应先看原因：Undeliverable 不会自动重试，Attempted 会自动重试。这两个状态也可能代表其他原因。

sections.title_en: Stopping is a choice about people already inside
sections.title_zh: 停止时要决定如何处理在途人员
sections.en: Stopping blocks new entrants and lets the operator either finish existing journeys or force immediate exit. Immediate exit cannot generally recall email, SMS, push or webhooks already sent to providers; native unopened in-app messages have a recall exception. Archiving ends active journeys and deletes unsent drafts. When restarting, choose current matches plus future additions or future additions only, with frequency rules still relevant. These choices deserve a written recovery scenario before launch.
sections.zh: 停止会阻止新人进入，操作者还需选择让已有旅程完成，或强制立即退出。立即退出通常无法撤回已交给服务商的邮件、短信、推送或 Webhook；原生且尚未打开的应用内消息存在撤回例外。归档会终止活动旅程并删除未发送草稿。重新启动时，需要选择当前匹配者加未来新增，或仅未来新增，同时仍受频率规则影响。上线前应写清这些选择对应的恢复场景。

sections.title_en: Model the data bill as well as the send bill
sections.title_zh: 同时估算数据与发送账单
sections.en: Public entry pricing is only the beginning of a cost model. Billing counts people and objects together and includes profiles present at any point in the cycle. Deleting and re-adding profiles can add another billable count. Emails reaching the ESP count even when they bounce or are suppressed there. Estimate object growth, synchronization churn and attempted sends alongside subscriber growth; validate negotiated terms in the account before procurement.
sections.zh: 公开起价只是成本模型的起点。人员与对象合并计费，周期内曾存在的档案都会计入。删除后重新添加档案可能再次增加计费数量。邮件到达 ESP 后，即使在那里退信或被抑制，也计入发送量。除了订阅者增长，还应估算对象增长、同步反复创建和发送尝试；采购前以账户中的议定条款核对。

seo.title_en: Customer.io: lifecycle automation, objects and journey controls
seo.title_zh: Customer.io：生命周期自动化、对象与旅程控制
seo.description_en: Evaluate Customer.io entry rules, draft sending, exits, retries and profile-based billing using current official documentation.
seo.description_zh: 依据当前官方文档评估 Customer.io 入场规则、草稿发送、退出、重试与档案计费。
seo.primary_intent: Understand Customer.io lifecycle automation and operational tradeoffs
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No account test, API event replay, channel delivery or billing reconciliation was performed.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试账户、API 事件重放、渠道投递或账单核对。

research_gaps.en: Exact negotiated overages, SMS charges, regional eligibility and interface languages remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体议定超额费用、短信费用、地区资格及界面语言仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Event idempotency and provider retry timing need a separate integration-specific test.
research_gaps.zh: 事件幂等性及服务商重试时序需要按具体集成另外测试。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
